description: This Ruby source file primarily defines classes for generating and managing HTML documentation from XML input files related to the 'lighttpd2' project. It includes classes for parsing XML modules and chapters, creating navigation structures, and rendering complete HTML pages with embedded documentation content.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Base class for representing and rendering HTML documentation pages generated from XML input.

classes.name: GenericModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Represents general module documentation, capable of rendering module details including parameters, options, and examples.

classes.name: ModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Specific subclass for 'module' XML elements with methods for parsing actions, setups, options, and sections.

classes.name: AngelModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Subclass for 'angel-module' XML elements with additional structures for items and sections.

classes.name: ChapterDocumentation
classes.description: Handles documentation structure for 'chapter' XML elements, including sections and examples.

classes.name: ModuleIndex
classes.description: Generates an index page listing modules and related categories.

classes.name: IndexPage
classes.description: Creates the main index page linking to other pages.

classes.name: AllPage
classes.description: Aggregates all documentation pages into a single comprehensive HTML page.

methods.name: loadXML
methods.description: Loads an XML file and returns an appropriate Documentation subclass instance based on the root element.
